summary: Iteration 3: validated the new patient-facing public form feature end-to-end (backend + frontend). Backend pytest 36/36 passed (31 regression + 5 new public form tests covering GET/submit/resubmit-block/bad-token/status-transition). Frontend Playwright flow verified: receptionist creates Intake form -> copy-link copies /form/{token} to clipboard -> unauthenticated context loads /form/{token}, renders clinic header, language toggle switches EN<->ES labels, all 6 Intake fields render with correct data-testid pf-<name>, submit shows public-form-success screen; revisiting the same token shows the already-submitted screen; /form/badtoken shows public-form-error state; staff-side Forms list shows the form as 'Received' and view-responses-<id> opens responses-view modal with the submitted answers (full_name, dob, reason).

ui_bugs.issue: Pre-existing: biller role still sees add-patient-btn in UI (backend correctly returns 403). Not part of this iteration but noted in prior report.

critical_code_review_comments: Backend: /api/public/forms/{token}/submit accepts any dict for `responses` without validating required fields from the template. A caller could submit `{}` and get status=received. Recommend server-side validation against template.required for defense-in-depth (client already enforces HTML5 required).
Backend: public_token is generated with uuid4().hex (128-bit random) which is sufficient; good.
Backend: no per-token rate limiting on /api/public/* endpoints — consider throttling to prevent enumeration/DoS (low risk since 404 on bad token, but no lockout).
PublicForm.js: displays clinic name hardcoded 'Veterans of Puerto Plata' both from backend response AND in the header shell — minor duplication but not a bug.

Forms.js: copy-link uses navigator.clipboard which requires HTTPS + user gesture; works in preview but should include a fallback + a toast on success (visually only relies on shadcn toast if implemented).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (added 5 tests: test_public_get_form_unauth, test_public_get_form_bad_token, test_public_submit_form_unauth, test_public_submit_resubmit_blocked, test_form_status_received_after_submit; also updated test_create_form to assert public_token+template and use form_type 'Intake' with correct casing)

success_rate.frontend: 100% on public form + staff-side responses viewer + regression

seed_data_creation: Created TEST_Intake_UI form (submitted with TEST_Public_User responses). Backend pytest also creates and cleans up TEST_ prefixed patient/appointment; the Playwright form row remains in DB (harmless demo data).
context_for_next_testing_agent: New feature is fully working. Public unauthenticated route /form/:token, GET+POST /api/public/forms/{token}, tokenized URL, bilingual (EN/ES) rendering via LanguageContext + template.en/es keys, and resubmit-blocking all verified. Only optional hardening item is server-side responses validation against template.required.
